'''August 2000 Raleigh tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Raleigh, NC on 12 August 2000. Mike Merletto (Light Side) won it. It is known from Mike Merletto's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1144">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-18-raleigh-nc-8-12-00d1144/ raleigh-nc-8-12-00], DeckTech (Mike "OQrygg" Merletto, 18 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-18-raleigh-nc-8-12-00d1144/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 12 August 2000
* '''Site:''' Raleigh, NC
* '''Format:''' [[Death Star II Sealed-Deck Starter Format]]
* '''Winner:''' Mike Merletto (Light Side)
